correctness.rationale: All group-atomic two-pick diagrams reduce to eight explicit relation/equality tests; square laws give full first-pick categories, with separate generic and exceptional n=2 treatment. Three rank-two sentences distinguish all seven classes. Two independently implemented exhaustive profile computations agree through n=56 and n=100, respectively. Finite computations supplement, not replace, the infinite proof.
